newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Wednesday set a one-week repo tender to add market liquidity up to a maximum of 2.0 billion crowns.
The minimum rate in the American-style tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.

The NBS added 2.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Tuesday with an average rate rising to 18.32 percent from 18.02 percent in a similar repo operation on Monday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity daily and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.

According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of August 5 lacked 0.55 percent of cumulative funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements. The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns in the current reserves period ending August 15.
